feature_queries.name: user_profile
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp,
       u.birthyear, (EXTRACT(year FROM e.timestamp) - u.birthyear) AS age,
       u.timezone, u.gender, u.locale
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = e.user

feature_queries.name: past_counts_multiwin
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days'  AND a.start_time < e.timestamp)  AS yesmaybe_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '14 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp)  AS yesmaybe_14d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp)  AS yesmaybe_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '60 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp)  AS yesmaybe_60d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp)  AS yesmaybe_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp) AS any_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN event_attendees a
  ON a.user_id = e.user
GROUP BY e.user, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: rates_and_recency
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT e.user, e.timestamp,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp) AS any_90d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND a.start_time < e.timestamp) AS yesmaybe_90d,
    MIN(date_diff('day', a.start_time, e.timestamp)) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time < e.timestamp) AS dsl_yesmaybe
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN event_attendees a ON a.user_id=e.user
  GROUP BY e.user, e.timestamp
)
SELECT user, timestamp,
  CASE WHEN any_90d=0 THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0*yesmaybe_90d/any_90d END AS rate_yesmaybe_90d_filled,
  COALESCE(dsl_yesmaybe, 9999) AS days_since_last_yesmaybe_filled,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(dsl_yesmaybe, 9999) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_yesmaybe_7d
FROM base

feature_queries.name: friend_degree
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp, COUNT(DISTINCT uf.friend) AS n_friends
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN user_friends uf ON uf.user=e.user
GROUP BY e.user, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: friend_activity_90d
feature_queries.sql:
WITH fe AS (
  SELECT e.user, e.timestamp, uf.friend AS friend_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN user_friends uf ON uf.user=e.user
)
SELECT fe.user, fe.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('yes','maybe') AND a.start_time >= fe.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND a.start_time < fe.timestamp) AS friends_yesmaybe_90d
FROM fe
LEFT JOIN event_attendees a ON a.user_id=fe.friend_id
GROUP BY fe.user, fe.timestamp

feature_queries.name: event_interest_signals
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.user, e.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.timestamp >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' AND i.timestamp < e.timestamp AND i.interested=1) AS interest_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN event_interest i ON i.user=e.user
GROUP BY e.user, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: friend_host_upcoming
feature_queries.sql:
WITH edges AS (
  SELECT e.user, e.timestamp, uf.friend AS friend_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN user_friends uf ON uf.user=e.user
)
SELECT ed.user, ed.timestamp,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ev.start_time >= ed.timestamp AND ev.start_time < ed.timestamp + INTERVAL '7 days') AS friend_host_events_next7d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ev.user_id) FILTER (WHERE ev.start_time >= ed.timestamp AND ev.start_time < ed.timestamp + INTERVAL '7 days') AS distinct_friend_hosts_next7d
FROM edges ed
LEFT JOIN events ev
  ON ev.user_id = ed.friend_id
GROUP BY ed.user, ed.timestamp
